title: The Naked Man
novel:
The gang [[discovered|discover]] a [[bold|bold]] dating technique called "The Naked Man." The idea was simple: when your date left the room, you [[stripped|strip]] naked and waited. [[Surprisingly|surprising]], it worked two out of three times.

Barney was [[thrilled|thrill]]. "This is [[genius|genius]]," he [[declared|declare]]. He wanted to try it immediately. Ted was [[skeptical|skeptical]] but [[intrigued|intrigue]].

Mitch, the man who [[invented|invent]] the technique, explained his [[philosophy|philosophy]]. "It shows [[confidence|confidence]]. It says, 'This is who I am.'"

Robin went on a date with Mitch. When she stepped out to answer a phone call, she returned to find him naked on her couch. She was [[stunned|stun]], then [[amused|amuse]], then [[horrified|horrify]].

"Really?" she said.

"Really," Mitch said [[calmly|calmly]].

Meanwhile, Lily and Marshall felt their [[romance|romance]] had become [[stale|stale]]. They tried to [[rekindle|rekindle]] the [[spark|spark]]. Marshall planned a [[surprise|surprise]] dinner, but Lily fell asleep on the couch. Marshall felt [[defeated|defeat]].

"We need to try harder," Lily said the next morning.

They [[attempted|attempt]] date night again — this time at a [[fancy|fancy]] restaurant. Halfway through dinner, Marshall [[knocked|knock]] over a glass of wine. They both laughed. The [[awkwardness|awkwardness]] broke the ice, and they felt [[connected|connect]] again.

Robin, meanwhile, [[rejected|reject]] Mitch. "The Naked Man doesn't work on me," she said firmly.

discover.en: to find something for the first time

bold.en: brave and not afraid of taking risks

genius.en: someone who is very smart or a brilliant idea

invent.en: to make or think of something new

philosophy.en: a way of thinking about life

stun.en: to surprise someone so much they cannot react

amuse.en: to make someone laugh or smile

horrify.en: to make someone feel very shocked

calmly.en: in a quiet and relaxed way

romance.en: the feeling of being in love

rekindle.en: to bring back a feeling again

spark.en: a small flash of feeling or energy

defeat.en: to make someone feel they have lost
